Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: locally_qualified_not_landed.
Assessment: Independent exact-source and final evidence PASS retained; no fresh gate run in this planning audit.
Staleness: Review status is truthful. Original implementation-next prose is superseded by final handoffs; no new implementation is implied.
Remaining / next action: Use bd-01M5E3J13V6CVABAMCRC69AG07 to audit all ancestors and qualify the actual integration/default-pin tree. Close this slice only after its authorized landing.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Outcome: ordinary CLI/JSON/export summaries visibly state the model being reported and its limited interpretation.
Scope: MappingPipeline run/batch summaries, WeightedMapping summaries, mapping docs and existing readers.
Acceptance: derive summary fields from executed profiles/receipts: reference level/universe and temperature; reconstruction profile/name, temperature, grouping order basis, decision policy and fill; normalized-score-mass versus model-posterior kind; structural admission distinct from validated factual-distortion detection/calibrated correctness. Source summary data from the executed objects, not caller assertions. Weighted metadata reports exact fraction, actual dispatched member, model temperature and decision policy, and explains no continuity promise at endpoints. Preserve raw argmax, chosen target/mass and fill origin distinctions. Add concise ordinary-user wording and machine-readable fields using existing vocabulary where possible; new vocabulary requires D/SD5 approval before it is introduced. Version changed wire contracts explicitly and prove legacy decoding/default numeric behavior. Independent JSON/TSV reader checks recover the same policies and reject contradictory metadata where it asserts authority; absent empirical validation stays explicit without invented validation scores.
Evidence: MappingPipelineSuite, MappingSettingsSuite, WeightedMappingSuite and external readback. This is interpretation/metadata work, not a scientific-label renaming across the library.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
